title: 八下 · 变化与问题解决训练卷
scope: 现在完成时、过去进行时、条件与时间从句、问题解决阅读及建议写作；原创笔试能力训练。
language: Mia has [[1]] the form, so we can send it now.
has 后需要过去分词；表格已完成，与现在可寄出相关。
completes 是第三人称单数形式，不是过去分词。
completing 不能直接与 has 构成这里的完成时。
At eight yesterday evening, we [[1]] the display boards.
过去明确时刻正在做，主语 we 为复数，用 were painting。
are painting 是现在进行时，不匹配过去参照时刻。
was 与 we 不一致。
This path is [[1]] than the road beside the river.
than 提示两者比较，用 steeper。
steepest 是最高级，不是这里两者之间的比较级。
不能同时叠用 more 和 -er。
If it [[1]] tomorrow, we will meet indoors.
真实的将来条件中，if 从句常用一般现在时 rains。
不能因 tomorrow 就在该 if 条件从句中机械使用 will。
rained 不符合这里真实将来条件与主句的搭配。
I will call you when the meeting [[1]].
谈将来时，when 时间从句常用一般现在时 ends。
不能把主句的 will 机械移入这个时间从句。
ended 不符合这里尚未发生的时间关系。
Our team enjoys [[1]] useful things from old paper.
enjoy 后不能在这里直接接动词原形。
enjoy 后通常接 doing，不在这里用 to do。
We decided [[1]] the signs before the next open day.
decide 后接 to do，表示决定做某事。
不能在这里用 decide doing 替代决定做的结构。
changed 不能直接接在 decided 后构成这个表达。
After practice, she explains the rules [[1]] than before.
比较说明规则的方式，用副词 clearly 的比较级 more clearly。
most clearly 是最高级，不符合 than before 的比较结构。
clearer 是形容词比较级，且不应再加 more。

cloze.text: For our class project, we made a model bridge from paper. Our first bridge held six coins. We changed the folds and tried again. This time it held nine. I wanted to write, 'Our new design is 〔1〕_____.' My partner asked whether the paper was the same. We looked at the pieces left on the table. The second sheet was twice as thick as the first. The second bridge used 〔2〕_____ paper, so we changed two things at once. We could not yet say which change caused the result. We made a third bridge with the new folds but the 〔3〕_____ type of paper as the first one. It held eight coins. We recorded every result, including the first one. The old attempt was not 〔4〕_____; it gave us something to compare with. Our final report described what we tested and what we still needed to 〔5〕_____.
items: better
worse
unchanged
Our first bridge held six coins.
九枚多于最初六枚，作者起初想用 better 评价新设计。
九枚多于六枚，作者最初想作正面评价，不是说更差。
折法和承重都发生变化，不能说完全未变。
thicker
thinner
equally thick
The second sheet was twice as thick as the first.
第二张纸厚度为第一张的两倍，所以是更厚的纸。
thinner 表更薄，与两倍厚相反。
equally thick 表一样厚，与两倍厚不符。
same
missing
third
as the first one.
same ... as 表与第一座使用相同类型的纸。
missing 表缺少的，与用这种纸实际做桥矛盾。
third 不能构成这里与第一种相同的 same ... as 结构。
useless
recorded
complete
it gave us something to compare with.
旧尝试提供比较基准，因此并非毫无用处。
前句说记录了每个结果，not recorded 会与之矛盾。
旧尝试已经做完，not complete 不是后文给出的价值判断。
check
hide
forget
what we still needed to
报告区分已经测试和仍需核对的部分。
hide 表隐瞒，不符合如实报告条件与结果的做法。
forget 表忘记，不符合保留记录以继续研究的情境。

reading.text:
WEEKEND DISPLAY UPDATE
The community history display will open as planned on Saturday morning. Only the outdoor photo walk has changed. It will take place on Sunday at ten instead of Saturday at ten, because heavy rain is expected on Saturday. Meet at the community hall for both the display and the walk. Visitors do not need a booking for the indoor display. The photo walk has twelve places, so book a place at the hall desk by Friday afternoon. If you booked for Saturday but cannot join on Sunday, tell the desk so someone else can use your place. Bring your own camera or phone for the walk. A guide will explain which places can be photographed.
items: Which activity has changed?
The outdoor photo walk.
The indoor history display.
Every activity at the community hall.
Only the outdoor photo walk has changed.
Only 限定只有户外摄影散步改变。
室内展览仍按计划周六开放。
不能把 Only 扩大成全部活动。
What is the new time for the walk?
Sunday at ten.
Saturday at ten.
Friday afternoon.
It will take place on Sunday at ten instead of Saturday at ten
新时间是周日十点；instead of 后是原安排。
周六十点是被替换的旧时间。
周五下午是预约截止时间，不是活动开始时间。
Why should someone cancel a place they cannot use?
Another person can then take that place.
The indoor display will otherwise close.
Every visitor must buy a new camera.
so someone else can use your place.
通知取消能把有限名额留给他人。
室内展览不依赖某人的步行预约。
原文要求自带设备，没有强制购买新相机。
Which visit needs a booking?
The photo walk.
The indoor display.
Any visit to the hall desk.
The photo walk has twelve places, so book a place
摄影散步有十二个名额，需要预约。
室内展览明示无需预约。
去服务台预约本身不需要另一次预约。

reading.text: The labels on our classroom drawers kept falling off. Some students wanted to buy stronger tape immediately. Before spending money, Qian watched how people used the drawers for two days. She noticed that the labels on the top corners fell off most often. Students' hands rubbed those corners when they opened the drawers. Qian moved two labels to the middle of their drawers and left two similar labels at the corners. A week later, both middle labels were still in place, while one corner label had fallen. The class kept watching for another week before moving the rest. They did not claim that tape never mattered. They had found a practical change worth testing in their room, with the materials and habits they actually had.
items: What did Qian do before trying a solution?
Observed how the drawers were used.
Replaced every drawer.
Bought the strongest tape she could find.
Qian watched how people used the drawers for two days.
她先观察使用过程，再提出改动。
原文只移动标签，没有更换抽屉。
买更强胶带只是一些同学最初的建议，并未立即执行。
What may explain why the corner labels fell off?
Hands rubbed the corners when opening drawers.
The labels became wet during cleaning.
No one used those drawers.
Students' hands rubbed those corners when they opened the drawers.
反复摩擦是观察到的可能原因。
原文没有清洗受潮的信息，记录的是开抽屉时手的摩擦。
恰恰是使用抽屉时的接触造成了问题，不是无人使用。
Why did Qian leave two similar labels at the corners?
To have something to compare with the moved labels.
To prove that every kind of tape is useless.
To stop students opening any drawer.
left two similar labels at the corners.
保留相似标签在旧位置，能与移到中间的标签作比较。
这种小比较不能证明所有胶带都无效。
文中没有封闭抽屉或禁止使用的安排。
Which conclusion matches the writer's caution?
The change was worth testing in that classroom.
Every classroom should remove all labels.
Labels will never fall off again after one week.
a practical change worth testing in their room
结论限定为本教室中值得继续测试的改动。
不能由一间教室的比较推广为所有教室移除标签。
一周结果不能保证以后永远不会脱落。

task.text:
PROJECT RECORD
Our group compared two paper boats with different folded shapes in the same tray. Boat A used one sheet, while Boat B used two. Both started with four counters. Boat A held six counters before sinking; Boat B held ten. We have not tested the boats in moving water. In the report, state the number of sheets as well as the results. Do not call the test a comparison of shape alone, because the amount of paper also changed.
items: Boat B used _____ sheets of paper. 填阿拉伯数字。
Boat B used two.
B使用两张纸；十是承受的计数片数量。
Boat A held _____ counters before sinking. 填阿拉伯数字。
Boat A held six counters before sinking
A下沉前承受六枚；四是两船最初都放入的数量。
The test did not compare shape _____. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
alone
Do not call the test a comparison of shape alone
材料用量也变了，不能说只比较形状。

writing.stem: 同学计划把标签全部换成更强的胶带。写一封约75—95词的英文建议邮件：先回应他的想法；建议观察标签在哪里脱落，并用少量标签比较位置；说明为什么不要立刻改动全部标签；最后鼓励记录和复查结果。不要声称一种办法永远有效。
writing.model:
Hi Sam,
Stronger tape may help, but I suggest checking the problem before changing every label. First, watch where the labels fall off and whether people's hands rub them. Then move a few labels to a different position and keep some similar ones where they are. This gives you something to compare. Record what happens for several days before deciding what to change next. One small test cannot show what will always work, but it can help you choose a useful next step.
Best wishes,
Qian
points: 先观察，再用少量标签比较位置
解释保留比较对象、避免全部同时改动
鼓励记录复查并限制结论范围
writing.organisation: 先回应，再按先后顺序给建议，各说明作用，友好结束。
writing.language: 检查 suggest doing、祈使句和比较表达；避免用 always 作无依据保证。
writing.format: 建议邮件有合理称呼与结束语
writing.pitfall: 不能把一周的小比较写成已经证明任何胶带都无效。
